adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts `createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, for destinations with `destination.credentialId`, it does `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` (when not found in cache) and then `await createEvent(...)` inside the loop. That is sequential per destination, unlike the `Promise.all(...)` used in the `else` branch, so end-to-end booking latency can grow roughly linearly with the number of destinations/hosts. This is a performance/latency concern rather than a correctness defect.
